fields: [pic=1]Ah Rascal! Join us for a round!

You two seem chipper,
what’s the celebration?
[pic=2]Just a couple of blokes havin’ a cold one after a romp!
[pic=1]A quite surprising one, I might add!
[pic=2]Heh, Rascal was actually there when Scarlett and I were planning it.
[pic=1]How many rounds did we go, four?
[pic=2]Hah, I just did two. You guys did four…
[pic=2]She’s back at the house cleaning up. She let us off the hook to get some beers!
I caught the tail end of it.
[pic=2]It all started just a bit ago.
[pic=3]Scarlett and I were testing out some of the gear you delivered us.
[pic=3]… I don’t think that was quite her words…
[pic=3]It sounded more like we were going to PICK UP beers…
[pic=7]Oh hello Rascal! Excuse me while I lose my cool on these two boys.
[pic=2]She strapped me to this apparatus, and put blinders on me.
[pic=1]See I like being at my wife’s mercy, so UH, I was already pretty excited.
[pic=3]She started preppin’ my rear with her tongue, right?
[pic=3]Slippin’ a few fingers in here ’n there - getting me ready.
[pic=2]So I’m expecting either a toy or somethin, right?
[pic=4]What on EARTH ARE YOU DOING lounging about?!
[pic=4]Oh you thought you’d leave me to clean up that mess?
[pic=4]There’s cum on the walls Peter, you know what happens if we let that sit.
[pic=4]Y-yes, love. I’ll go help clean it up.
[pic=4]Oh no you don’t. You’re not off the hook either! Half of the mess is all you!
[pic=2]Ahh… see, I would but… these old bones, y’know? I gotta rest!
[pic=4]Nope. You clearly didn’t need a rest plowing my husband.
[pic=7]Rascal, I hope you have a lovely afternoon. [pic=7]Take care, now!
